authority_effect: This payload grants no authority until the user explicitly accepts this exact file SHA-256. After acceptance and post-publication activation, it pre-authorizes the complete still-valid timed happy path without another mid-run approval prompt.
scope: Demo 3 timed dress rehearsal only; not Demo 2, Demo 4, the final live event, or any unrelated repository work.

pre_publication_state.complete_preparation_manifest_sha256: must be calculated and separately approved immediately before Task 58 publication
pre_publication_state.actual_published_baseline_sha: must be derived after the normal Task 58 push
pre_publication_state.actual_timed_range_sha_and_stable_hash: must be calculated and proven immediately before the timed child publication push

separate_preparation_publication_gate.requirement: Task 58 needs separate explicit human approval of its final exact preparation manifest and stable range hash before staging, commit, or push.
separate_preparation_publication_gate.activation_after_publication: event-authority-activation.json must bind the actual published baseline SHA, fetched origin/main equality, the accepted preparation manifest/tree hashes, this authority hash, and the released root writer lease.

designated_execution.root_integration_owner: exclusive preparation and child publication writer

authorized_timed_happy_path_after_activa: claim and complete the bound Demo 3 child chain without editing authored source, design, topology, binding, interface, or seal
edit only paths and operations in event-allowlist.json
run local validation and production-safe smoke tests
create at most four bounded in-scope commits under the two-pre-publication and one-production repair policy
have the root integration owner perform one normal non-force push to origin/main
inspect the two existing Vercel projects and deployments read-only
verify /demo/3/ and /demo/3/output/ with bounded public GET requests
record the child checkpoint, timing ledger, consolidated reveal receipt, and public-safe post-reveal evidence
have the root integration owner refresh and verify the program bundle and root projection
no_mid_run_reapproval: No additional approval is required for an authorized action while every bound identity, lease, baseline, origin observation, deadline, and attempt limit remains valid. Any drift is a hard blocker, not an invitation to broaden authority during the presentation.

repair_and_timing.fallback: select the sealed Demo 2 result transparently by T+30 if the Demo 3 gate has not passed

validity.not_before: Goal 6 readiness is accepted, Task 58's separately approved preparation baseline is published, HEAD equals fetched origin/main, event-authority-activation.json verifies, the root writer lease is released, and immutable T0 is recorded immediately before dispatch
validity.expires: the earliest of T0+30:00, explicit human revocation, bound identity drift, origin drift, lease invalidation, owner drift, or exhausted repair policy
validity.wall_clock_event_window: the later activation receipt supplies the actual activated_at and expires_at values

local_evidence_only_boundary.exact_inventory: the complete local_evidence_only_inventory object in event-authority-policy.json, bound by its SHA-256 above
local_evidence_only_boundary.rule: These program status, event, checkpoint, index, receipt, bundle, and root projection paths may change locally but are excluded from the preparation manifest and every timed push.
local_evidence_only_boundary.correction_to_bound_content: invalidates this authority and requires fresh human acceptance

publication_boundary.exact_inventory: the canonical_paths and child_run.publication_eligible_paths in event-allowlist.json, bound by its SHA-256 above
publication_boundary.rule: These are not dirty-state exceptions; the root integration owner may stage them only after accepted local and canonical validation plus writer release.

hard_blockers: origin/main advances after the final preflight
a push would require force, history rewrite, or unrelated integration
credentials or required provider visibility are unavailable
source, binding, interface, seal, sendoff, allowlist, policy, handoff, lease, fallback, baseline, owner, validity, or deadline identity drifts
a required action needs an unlisted path, provider mutation, or other forbidden action
the two/one repair policy or T+30 global deadline is exhausted
forbidden: force push, history rewrite, unrelated integration, tags, or package publication
new dependencies, lockfile edits, web research, image generation, remote fonts/assets, or new route architecture
DNS, Vercel project/environment/alias configuration, analytics, or manual redeploy
credentials, tokens, cookies, raw provider payloads, or private context in artifacts
editing this authority, the lease, allowlist, approval, validity window, run binding, interface, or immutable seal from the writable child
claiming Demo 3 succeeded after a hard blocker or missed selection gate
